points.quote: Using generative artificial intelligence tools (e.g. ChatGPT) in an assessment unless explicitly permitted to do so and with proper acknowledgement, is a form of plagiarism.
points.gist: Using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT in an assessment without explicit permission and proper acknowledgement counts as plagiarism.

points.quote: Verification may take the form of an oral verification interview (see Appendix 3: Guidelines for Staff on the Conduct of Oral Verification Interviews) with the submitting learner or learners, using plagiarism detection software (e.g. Turnitin), or any other process appropriate to a particular discipline to safeguard Academic Integrity.
points.gist: Lecturers may verify originality through an oral verification interview, plagiarism detection software such as Turnitin, or another discipline-appropriate process.
